description_nl: 2026-09-18: a phone recording is often HEVC (H.265). Copied into the narrated MP4 it made Windows ask for a paid 'HEVC Video Extensions' codec before it would play. A recording in a portable_codecs format is copied as it is (fast, no quality lost); anything else is re-encoded to H.264, which every phone, browser and TV plays with nothing to buy.
weight_basis: Owner-only (audience admin): these knobs decide whether the video this portal hands out plays for free or asks the viewer to buy a codec, and how much CPU every render costs.
